title: Fantastic experience!
text: We did a 3 hour private tour. Our guide, Philippe, was very knowledgeable and brought us to many great places, including the waterfront and Olympic stadium.  We both had limited Segway experience,  and our guide gave good instruction and made me feel safe. 100% recommend for everyone!
author: Kimberly_M

title: Fun Introduction to Barcelona
text: We had a great time on our Segway tour.  First time ever on a Segway and was a little nervous.  Our guide gave us instructions and we were able to practice in a square before hitting the streets.  We felt completely safe.  He did a great job of introducing us to the city and history of Barcelona.  We learned a lot and had a great time doing it.  Highly recommend!
author: April_D

title: Super trip well looked after
text: Really good don’t worry about not being able to do it, Philip looked after my partner and ensured she was confident and secure, absolute legend and would comeback and recommend to anyone she was apprehensive prior but after our trip it was the highlight of the day super well worth a 5* rating
author: Philip_G

title: Awsome tour of Barcelona!
text: Awesome tour of Barcelona. Our guide Ivan ensured we were comfortable on the Segways and then off we went. He stopped often and told us about many Barcelona areas, the related history, impact of the Olympic and some Gaudi highlights. Was a great way to see places that would take days to find on foot. It was fun and informative.
author: Anthony_B

title: Fun way to see the city!
text: Such a great way to see Barcelona. The segways were so easy to use. Don’t be intimidated or scared. We picked it up in about 5 minutes and it wasn’t scary at all. Our tour guide Ivan was friendly and knowledgeable and he showed us parts of the city I know we would have otherwise missed. Did this with our three teenage children and they loved it!
author: Stacey_A

title: Great way to tour the city- our first time on segways!
text: Perfectly curated, individualized tour. I came with my 18yo and 16yo. Our guide Felipe knew exactly what we needed. We stayed busy and went to Montjuk mountain, down toward the beach and along Barcelona, the beach, Olympic village, arc du triomphe, fountains of the citadel park… Segway felt super safe and it was all of our first time.  The tourists on e-bikes looked at us enviously. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Bonnie_C

title: Fabulous
text: Pablo was fantastic. The wonderful paths thru the city and his knowledge make it a must for all travelers.   Thank you for a great time and highlight of our trip:)
author: James_E

title: Fantastic time
text:
Fabulously FUN way to see Barcelona!  
The guides were patient with us and knowledgable about the city.
author: Scott_B

title: Made Me Love Barcelona
text: We selected this tour for the second day of our second trip to Barcelona.  Our guide, Philip was amazing and took us to the top of Montjuic and throughout the Olympic installations.  It was amazing.  We went places we never would have gone because it would have been too much walking over too inclined a path.  As I told Philip, before that day, I liked Barcelona, but did not love it.  Philip and this tour was the turning point and made me love Barcelona.  He and this tour created an unforgettable moment for us.  Fun, exciting and worthwhile!
author: Christine_M

title: Amazing!
text: This tour is amazing!! We are so glad to have chosen them. We learned a lot from Ivan and Leo. We saw new places we had never seen before in Barcelona. Highly recommended!
author: JHON_B
